ti.title: ሚካኤል’ዩ
ti.lyrics:
[[chorus]]
ቅድስቲ ኣፎምያ ስምካ ዝጸውዐት
ተገለጽካላ ምሕረት ረኸበት
ንዓይ ክትረድእ ዝተሸየምካ
ናይ ምሕረት መልኣኽ ሚካኤል ኢኻ
[[/chorus]]

ሚካኤል’ዩ ዋልታ ናይ ሕይወተይ ደጋፍየይ
ካብ መከራ ቀልጢፉ ዘውጽኣ ንሕይወተይ

ካብ መከራ ውሕጅ ንኸድኅነኒ
ሚካኤል መጺኡ ክንፉ ኣርኣየኒ
ዝምክሓሉ ዝኣምኖ ኣነ
ሚካኤል’ዩ ምሳይ ዝቖመ

ti_ro.title: Mikael’yu
ti_ro.lyrics:
Mikael’yu walta nay hywetey degafyey
Kab mekera qeltifu zewtsa nhywetey
Qdsti afomya smka ztsewat
Tegeletskala mhret rekhebet
Nay ktred ztesheyemka
Nay mhret melakh mikael ikha
Kab mekera whj nkhedhneni
Mikael metsiu knfu arayeni
Zmkhalu zamno ane
Mikael’yu msay zqome
Bhmam dewe ztecheneqku
Selam zeybley kertet zbelku
Bmikael’ye ztefewesku
Amesgnuley ll nabelkum
